title: Chapter 910
paragraphs: Chapter 910
Episode 228. The Battle of Groshay Castle (6)
Boom, Kwaaaaaa…!

Distant sounds of explosion could be heard. Unlike the Vamel Alliance, which had crushed the first line of defense a while ago, fierce battles were still underway on the left, right, and rear defense lines.
Only the Vamel Alliance had perfectly won the first battle and had time to reorganize.
As confirmed so far, the demonic realm's defenses consist of five layers. Meaning, four more lines of defense needed to be crushed before the main fortress could be hit.
'The real deal starts from the main fortress. Hence, we need to push them back as quickly as possible until we get there, then adjust the pace while figuring out when Phaelito is going to come out.'
Or there was another way, to apply heavy pressure on the main fortress so that Phaelito couldn't even touch the sacred kingdom. That was the best strategy.
"Bale."
{This is Bale Runcandel, I'm listening.}
Since becoming the center of the defense line, Bale had been quickly building a sense of duty and pride as a member of the family and the alliance.
The internal experience points gained through many events since joining the alliance were exploding all at once. It was a result of protecting people as the guardian of the defense line.

What was precious to Bale now was not just the late Sarah Runcandel. He sincerely wanted to protect all the alliance members and comrades who believed and fought with him. In other words, he was maturing. He was becoming a figure worthy of a Runcandel Knight.
Jin smiled, reading the heart contained in Bale's voice on the other end of the communicator.
"We're starting the breakthrough again. This time you go first and deal with the demons at the front line. I'll rest a little more, 30 minutes, then set off."
{Got it, Master. But only 30 minutes after Murakan and I wiped out the first line of defense? Let me know if you want to rest more, I can sweep them up all by myself.}
"You're getting quite confident, Bale. 30 minutes is more than enough."
[Well, I guess I could go without rest. The ones we took down earlier were just a warm-up. See you later.]
Fiiiiiing-!
Bale spread his wings and accelerated quickly. The sound of the air exploding marked his path, a comet-like golden trail painted across the sky.
The demons at the defense line feared Bale.
They had clearly seen his exploits as the guardian of the barrier. The way he dyed the entire sky with his golden authority, slaughtering the demons.
Aaaaargh...!

As Bale's power began to fill the sky, the remaining poison of Ragal quickly dissipated. It was a solo breakthrough, but it was not Bale who was ready to face death, but the demon army of the second line of defense, nearing millions.
"Their attack has begun again, ready the army!"
"Target the cannons! The 1st and 2nd fleets focus on Bale, and the rest prepare for artillery battle with the enemy!"
Aware of their bitter defeat in the first battle, the demons placed the Demon King and warlords directly at the front.
Monstrous cannons protruded from the demon ships. Bale, even under the sight of these cannons, did not even set up a shield.
Because he could avoid them all.

[Our lord enters battle ignoring our friendly fire, even the main cannon of the golden ship. I wonder if any of you have the courage to keep me bound? If you don't interfere like this, you'll never hit me with a cannon.]
Just as Bale finished speaking, a Demon King flew towards him, brandishing his sword.
Squeak! Bale destroyed his stance with his wings and cut off his arm, and at that moment, the targeted cannons poured out a purple light all at once.
The Demon King tried to pull out his body, but Bale continued to bind him with his wings and used him as a shield. The demon cannons instantly turned the Demon King into a rag.
"Kahaaak!"
[You shouldn't shoot your allies, you idiots.]
Then Shakan split the body of the regenerating Demon King in half. Waves of golden sword energy spread like a tsunami and fell onto the fleet.

The sword energy spread widely as soon as it hit the flagship, covering the demons like a net. The demons, even if slightly grazed by this energy, were electrocuted and bent their bodies. If they barely held on to their senses, they had to experience the sensation of their bodies disintegrating.
In other words, ordinary soldiers were meaningless to Bale. Thousands, or tens of thousands of ordinary soldiers only served to delay Bale's advance for a few seconds.
[Those who are only Demon Kings by title, those who are merely called generals, bugs that are inferior to vermin, all are meaningless.]
The commanders of the demon army had no strength to respond to the harsh words.
While Jin had saved some energy for the additional battle earlier, the solar energy that Bale possessed was near infinite.

Moreover, if there was no force that could extinguish the energy of the sun god, Bale could not be brought to 'complete death'. Unfortunately, among the demons in the second line of defense, there was no one with such ability.

[I am invincible, immortal, while you are weak and finite. I am Bale, Bale Runcandel, a knight of Runcandel, an existence that annihilates and annihilates the enemies of the family. I am the enemy of mortals...! Yes, I am Bale. Bale Runcandel!]
Jin, who was meditating on the golden ship, unexpectedly burst into laughter at those words.
"Kid, it seems like he's going through something similar to puberty as he grows up, right? He spews such childish lines... It gives me goosebumps. It's self-absorption, huh."
"Still, he's a lot more pleasant to look at than when we first met. As he matures, it'll become an embarrassing memory he'll want to forget."
Jin, Murakan, and their allies found humor and a sense of empathy in Bale's words.
However, the demons didn't. To them, Bale's childish words sounded like a grave judgement from the defunct ancient demons.

With each blink, demons close to the tens of thousands turned into golden ashes. The sea was constantly littered with the wreckage of the Demon World Army's fleet, and the air was stained with golden powers and screams.
Most of the thirteen Demon Kings positioned in the second line of defense couldn't even properly counterattack Bale.
It wasn't just because of the power difference. It was difficult to keep up with his speed, flitting across the battlefield as fast as light.
The Demon Kings aimed at Bale but ended up striking their own allies. Each time, chaos accelerated and the formation collapsed.
Of course, if they all poured out their power at once, even Bale would have to hesitate. After all, there were thirteen of them, even if they weren't the highest-ranking Demon Kings.

But the Demon Kings were conscious of the allied forces, who were watching from a distance with their eyes wide open. If they carelessly poured out everything only for Bale to withdraw, leaving only their power, and the allied forces to close in, it would be a disaster.
The Demon Kings, despite accepting the huge damage to their lower-level forces, wanted to prepare for when Jin and Murakan would attack again.
But the Demon Kings couldn't maintain that judgement.

Gradually, Bale began to inflict direct damage not only on the regular soldiers but also on the Demon Kings. Whenever the bond of the Demon Kings protecting each other was even slightly disrupted, Shakan would swoop in without fail.
"...We must use the Flesh! If this continues, we'll only end up being beaten. Even if they join in, we must catch Bale!"
A Demon King shouted. The one named Telbit was the strongest among the Demon Kings in the second line of defense.
There was nothing worse than losing forces like this and falling, or being swept away by the joined allied forces.
Thirteen Demon Kings decided to use thirteen pieces of Flesh simultaneously. It was the moment when the most Flesh was used in a single battle since the Demon World War began.
The Demon Kings judged that if they combined all the Flesh they had, they could exert a power similar to that of the original divine power used by Sakiel to stop Jin and Murakan.
Grrr...!
Suddenly, their vision darkened.
Bale flinched and glared at the Demon Kings. The golden powers that filled the sky were being eroded by magic.
Then, Bale fully opened his powers, but it only slightly slowed down the speed at which the battlefield was being colored with magic.
'My infinite power... is being pushed back. Just like when I faced Jin's eternity...!'
"Even Jin and Murakan had to retreat when Sakiel used the Flesh in the past, and they didn't confront it head-on. It was inevitable that Bale would find it difficult to handle.
Zito is an entity that can completely obliterate 'Traces of Life,' the power of the Sun God held by Bale. By using Zito's Flesh, the demon kings were borrowing his authority.
If it was the Bale of the past, he would have been taken aback by the sudden onset of a crisis. Those who become strong not through training, but by nature, tend to lose their way in such moments.
However, Bale tightened his grip on his sword with renewed energy.
Looking back, he had been becoming a knight without even knowing it, both when he was in Runcandel a thousand years ago and after he met Jin and returned to Runcandel.
'If my zeal weakens due to the disparity in power, I won't be able to face Sarah with pride someday.'
Then, Bale, like Jin, Luna, or even his great comrades from a thousand years ago, swung Shakan as if chanting a spell.
The golden power accumulated on the blade of his sword was becoming infinitely bright, turning into a pure aura.

Bale's sword energy drew a massive semicircle, sharply bisecting the center of the purple sky. It was not a divine authority that he had from birth, but a result created by his martial arts as a knight.
The demon kings were taken aback by the unexpected blow, but Zito's energy soon filled the sky again.
'...I thought you only relied on the energy of the Sun God. You have a foundation, Bale.'
At Telbit's words, Bale widened his eyes and shouted back.
{I am from Runcandel, one who grows stronger when fighting with a sword, not power. Come... Demons, let me cut you all down.}
'Watch your feet while you talk, arrogant fragment of the Sun God. You seem to have missed it while concentrating on swinging your sword like a knight who has reached the pinnacle of his plight.'
Although Bale didn't look directly at his feet, he could feel it. The magical energy whirling as if to devour him.

At the same time Telbit used Zito's Flesh, he had performed dark magic, offering the corpses of the fallen demon kings and soldiers as a sacrifice. The highest level sealing magic, curse, and illusion magic that he had directly learned from Sakiel were seething within the whirlpool.
[Damn it...!]
The first thing that struck Bale was an illusion. Bale gritted his teeth at the vivid illusion of Sarah being horribly murdered.
Then, at the moment when the seal and curse tried to bind Bale one after another,
'Your comment was a bit excessive, but today, you were the most like Runcandel I've seen, Bale.'

[I thought I would die laughing at the things you've been saying while fighting. But you've grown a lot compared to the dumb guy who only knew about Sarah. Uh, now you look a bit like a Knight of the Tenth Rank.]
Jin and Murakan cut through the magical energy and took their places beside Bale."
